research.topic: Eat the frog — tackling your hardest/most important task first
research.hook: What if I told you that doing the hardest thing first and then napping can double your exam scores? Try it for 3 days and watch the magic happen.
research.tip: Use the 50/5 Frog‑First Routine: 50 min on your toughest task, 5‑min stretch break, then a 20‑min power nap before the next work block.

data.title: Hardest Assignment Pehle Karo, Stress Kam, Marks Double!
data.title_en: Do the Hardest Task First, Reduce Stress, Boost Grades

scenes.text: Kya tumhara hardest assignment har din tumhe thakata hai?
scenes.text_en: Does your hardest assignment tire you every day?

scenes.text: Sab log pehle easy kaam karte, frog baad mein.
scenes.text_en: Everyone does easy work first, the frog later.

scenes.text: Research kehti hai subah ki willpower sabse zyada hoti.
scenes.text_en: Research says morning willpower is the highest.

scenes.text: Pehele apna sabse dreaded task, yaani frog, chun lo.
scenes.text_en: First pick your most dreaded task, the frog.

scenes.text: Timer set karo 50 minute, bina distraction ke kaam karo.
scenes.text_en: Set a timer for 50 minutes, work without distraction.

scenes.text: Timer khatam hone par 5 minute stretch ya walk karo.
scenes.text_en: When the timer ends, do a 5‑minute stretch or walk.

scenes.text: Uske baad 20 minute power nap lo, lights dim.
scenes.text_en: After that, take a 20‑minute power nap, dim the lights.

scenes.text: Isse stress kam hota aur focus improve hota.
scenes.text_en: It helps reduce stress and improve focus.

scenes.text: Ye tip us dost ko bhejo jo hamesha procrastinate karta.
scenes.text_en: Send this tip to that friend who always procrastinates.

scenes.text: Aur teesra step, yaani nap, sabse zaroori hai.
scenes.text_en: And the third step, the nap, is the most important.

scenes.text: Aaj se 50/5 frog routine try karo, farak dekho.
scenes.text_en: Start the 50/5 frog routine today, see the difference.

scenes.text: Results may vary; individual experiences differ.
scenes.text_en: Results may vary; individual experiences differ.

data.description: A quick 45‑second reel showing why doing your toughest task first, followed by a short nap, boosts focus and reduces stress, with a simple 50/5 routine you can start today.
